title: Fillion: a real-time tool for finding and understanding AI-assisted trade setups
author: Affectionate-Rule-52
selftext:
Fillion is a real-time tool for finding and understanding stock and options setups.



Enter a ticker and it brings the live research workflow into one view: price structure, technical levels, fundamentals, recent news and catalysts, options positioning, a market thesis, and evidence on both sides. When a setup is available, Fillion explains the entry, invalidation or cancellation condition, stop, target, and time window.



The goal is not to hand you a black-box buy/sell signal. It is to help you spot a potential setup, understand why it exists, see the risk, and know what would break the idea as conditions change.



I’m looking for traders willing to test one ticker and challenge the output:



• Did it help you find a setup faster?

• Could you understand the setup and risk at a glance?

• Were the levels and invalidation conditions actionable?



Try it: [https://www.fillion.ai](https://www.fillion.ai)



Disclosure: I’m involved with Fillion. It is research-only, not an auto-trader or signal service. Not financial advice.
